identification: Sciter 3.3.2.2, sciter32.dll, native HTML/CSS and TIScript UI engine
judgment: The coherent rendering/scripting engine, inert attach callback and caller-driven UI capabilities support a bundled legitimate library. Traced hooks dispatch messages, clipboard code handles text and process launch is parameterized. No traced autonomous credential theft, persistence or malicious payload activation. Container conviction is not inherited.
limitations: Static analysis only; no execution or endpoint contact.
Embedded vendor/version claims are not independently authenticated. Original distribution provenance and host application invocation context are unavailable.

extraction.difference: Historical SizeOfImage carve includes 31,744 bytes beyond PE sections. Tail contains 16 complete CRC-checked PNG images and the beginning of another. Current extractor uses physical section bounds.

execution_paths: 0x1023c69a -> CRT dispatch 0x1023c5a4 -> DLL callback 0x1001c4fd. Attach returns success; detach releases engine state. SciterAPI 0x10014102 returns table 0x10350040.

0x10032e19 installs WH_GETMESSAGE (3) on current thread. 0x1015fb00 installs a message hook; 0x1015fa70 filters TOOL-EXEC-ASYNC, invokes queued callback, signals event and forwards through CallNextHookEx.
0x100ad3ca reads clipboard text and custom formats with GlobalLock/Unlock. Script dispatcher 0x1018ee16 exposes clipboard operations; 0x1018f109 polls the clipboard sequence counter.

0x10125b02 sends caller-supplied HTTP request parameters. Error 12045 handling prompts, rejects or sets security option 31 with mask 0x100 before retry, depending on configuration. Existing TLS unknown-CA detection retained.

0x1026e80b calls CreateProcessW in CRT spawn machinery with caller arguments, inherited-handle management, wait/exit-code retrieval and cleanup. Script target opener uses ShellExecuteExW at 0x1018cece.
0x10244907 constructs stack-cookie exception 0xc0000409, checks debugger state for exception handling and terminates the current process. This is not an autonomous anti-analysis gate.
0x1021cd50 passes callback, user argument and timing parameters to timeSetEvent; no audio input claim.

Native fromBase64 method table references 0x101f70f0, which parses script arguments and calls 0x10177200. The latter initializes A-Z/a-z/0-9 inverse ranges and +/ entries, then accumulates 6-bit groups and emits bytes.
Decoded string candidates are incidental binary/PNG text and formatting strings; no decoded executable stage was established.
